description:
SOURCE: hardening pass 2026-05-29 (multi-layer sync discipline added to CLAUDE.md + steward task).
WHY: walkthrough content lives in 3 layers (beat_scripts.md prose / walkthrough_html/beat<N>.html visual / SKILL.md nav) that can silently drift. The hazard may already have bitten before the discipline existed.
TASK: across all 5 walkthrough skills (overview, as-memory, as-bus, for-meta-analysis, for-decisions) verify each beat's prose in beat_scripts.md matches its walkthrough_html/beat<N>.html and its SKILL.md one-line summary. (overview has beat2_everyone.html + beat2_coder.html.)
ACCEPTANCE: a per-skill per-beat sync report posted as a comment; any drift found is fixed in-place or spun off as its own child ticket (with all affected layers enumerated).

comments.text: LAYER-SYNC AUDIT COMPLETE (bws-vk0.7) — 5 walkthrough skills x 3 layers (beat_scripts.md / SKILL.md / walkthrough_html), rendered close images verified directly. RESULT: layers substantively IN SYNC on content, routing, personas, pricing. 2 minor drifts: [A] alt-text vs image authorship mismatch — 3 skills (overview, for-meta-analysis, for-decisions). - Close-beat alt attribute describes a caption crediting "Denson Smith": - skills/beadwork-overview/walkthrough_html/beat4.html L19: "...open source. authored by Denson Smith. bw itself by jallum..." - skills/beadwork-for-meta-analysis/walkthrough_html/beat4.html L17: "...open source. Denson Smith. bw itself by jallum." - skills/beadwork-for-decisions/walkthrough_html/beat4.html L17: "...open source. Denson Smith. bw itself by jallum." - BUT the actual rendered images (overview beat5-close.jpg, others beat4-close.jpg) credit jallum ONLY: "open source, MIT-licensed. bw by jallum (github.com/jallum/beadwork)". beat_scripts.md image-spec is jallum-only too, and each on-page callout is jallum-only. - So the alt-text is inaccurate and contradicts the image + beat_scripts.md + the skill's user-facing no-self-credit rule. Impact LOW (alt-text only; sighted users see the correct caption). - FIX: correct each alt caption clause to "open source, MIT-licensed. bw by jallum (github.com/jallum/beadwork)." (HTML aligned to already-correct canonical prose; no beat_scripts.md change.) [B] stale image extension in prose — beadwork-as-bus. - skills/beadwork-as-bus/beat_scripts.md documents the Beat 3 image as beat3-scenarios.jpg; actual asset + HTML use beat3-scenarios.png. FIX: prose .jpg -> .png. CLEAN: beadwork-as-memory; and all content/routing/persona/pricing across all 5 skills. Both fixes are mechanical alignments to the already-correct layer. Pending go-ahead (authorship-adjacent), then fix + commit + push.
Landed on main at 3248739d0b19f19827a084f901f21a480fca26b0: 3 alt-text corrections + as-bus prose .jpg->.png. All walkthrough layers now in sync.

title: Verify walkthrough layer-sync (beat_scripts <-> HTML <-> SKILL) across 5 skills
